description: Na₆Ge₂S₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaS₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-40°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.29 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.41 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.71 Å) and two longer (2.77 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.08 Å. Ge⁴⁺ is bonded to four S²⁻ atoms to form GeS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaS₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-59°. There are a spread of Ge-S bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.27 Å. There are four inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-78°. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the third S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge⁴⁺ atom. In the fourth S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ge⁴⁺ atoms.
